seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms as rookie couriers and gradually uncovers a widening conspiracy — Ugathul imposters wearing stolen Blackline badges, radar dishes spreading a mysterious signal across Hallia, and Grayson's necromantic Fane hidden deep beneath the sewers.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A devastating total party kill at the Crowded Flea sends Johnny and Benny's souls into the void, where the entity Aut offers a costly return. Reformed and diminished, the party hunts down Roundhat Gang leaders Hlarf and Tywelwyn, discovering that six alien gods are using radar dishes to crack the Firmament.

seasons.title: The Poncho Boys Ride Out
seasons.arc_summary: After wrapping up the Tywelwyn case and rescuing Anaïs — who reveals Aut is one of five cosmic siblings called the Narrative — the party attends a massive pilgrimage gathering, surviving a gladiatorial trial and a scavenger hunt to secure a keystone granting passage aboard a colossal Strider bound for the Void Side Wall.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During six months of downtime, Argyle returns half-alive and suspicious, the party uncovers a hairline fracture in reality beneath Teller's Run revealing an imprisoned two-mile-tall god, and bombs the research facility before the Harlequin announces the Strider's imminent departure.

seasons.title: Welcome to the Neighborhood
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal Strider, the party creates their own Fane, builds a coalition of surviving factions, delves deep into the Undercroft to ally with the ancient Machine God, and endures the weekly tithe that drains factions of their life energy.

seasons.title: The Voidheart and the Hand
seasons.arc_summary: The party assaults the sleeping clan's hospital stronghold, accidentally destroys the Menhir — a member of the Narrative — with a god-killing revolver that strands the Strider far off the known map, then fights through corrupted Harlequins and Galzu's surreal Fane to secure the Undercott and free a Herald-bound gunslinger.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Joker World Expedition
seasons.arc_summary: As one one-shot ends, a squad of Scale operatives is dispatched to a shattered Joker World, where they breach the fiend-built Quorum, descend through the bloodfall portal, and free Voice of Many — a divine heart and grandchild of the Judge — from its fiendish captors before escaping back to headquarters. The run is a single continuous expedition, with every episode flowing directly into the next, so it stands as one season.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: The Convox detectives travel to Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a missing Green Father worshipper, following a Feyrock necklace deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse where they rescue a lost child and battle a fey court — only to learn their prime suspect is already dead and the curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: Returning to Hallia, the Convox traces fey stone to a jeweler's conference and then to a ritualist's apartment, where they discover bodies being transmuted into fey stone via a cursed book — and are themselves pulled into the Gloaming Codex's deadly pages.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Sedecium Fire Team
seasons.arc_summary: The Sedecium agents Foral, Scrazzy, and Ozzie undertake perilous missions into the slip — first investigating a derelict observatory to uncover the Thessian Esoterica's interest in a massive magical spike near the Astra's core, then raiding the corpse of a dead god for divine essence before the God Eater Harrow can consume it all.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
